summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the second of three installments of its cash dividend, as resolved by the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting and authorized by the BCRA on May 15, 2026. The dividend is an aggregate of $23,003,675,041, equating to $37.5441433549 per share, representing 3,754.4% of capital stock (reflecting the par value structure under Argentine law). Record date is July 1, 2026, with payment beginning July 6, 2026. Holders of ADSs will receive payment via The Bank of New York Mellon. Argentine withholding taxes may apply. This is a routine dividend distribution and does not constitute a special situation.
